title: Contradictory terms of instrument.
bodyText: If an instrument contains contradictory terms, typewritten terms prevail over printed terms, handwritten terms prevail over both, and words prevail over numbers.
bodyHtml: §490:3-114  Contradictory terms of instrument.  If an instrument contains contradictory terms, typewritten terms prevail over printed terms, handwritten terms prevail over both, and words prevail over numbers. [L 1991, c 118, pt of §1]
